title: Oscillating Reactions
description: Belousov was told his reaction was impossible: a mixture that changes colour and back again, on a beat, all by itself. Unlocks the Oscillator Vessel.

puzzle.goal: In the simplest model of a reaction that keeps a beat, with feeds A and B, the steady mixture turns unstable and starts to oscillate once B passes a threshold b. Write b.
puzzle.name: Hopf threshold
puzzle.method: Linearise round the steady state X = A, Y = B/A: the trace of the matrix, B − 1 − A², changes sign there.
